people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
translations.bsb: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
translations.kjv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
